title: Kitesurfing in Paje
excerpt: Paje on Zanzibar's east coast is a well-known kitesurfing spot, with a shallow lagoon and steady winds. Lessons, seasons and tips.
body:
Paje is a village on the east coast of Zanzibar with a wide lagoon of shallow, turquoise water. Together with steady trade winds, it is popular for kitesurfing.

## Seasons

The kite seasons follow the monsoon winds: roughly June to September (Kusi, from the south) and December to February or March (Kaskazi, from the north).

## Lessons

Several kite schools offer lessons for beginners and rentals for experienced kiters. The shallow water makes learning easier.

## Tides

The tidal differences are big. At low tide the lagoon becomes very shallow. Schools plan around the tides.

## Not kiting?

Paje is also good for relaxing, yoga and walks along the beach.

## Respect

Watch out for seaweed farmers in the lagoon; they work in the shallow water.
